answer: A refundable identity bond is the concrete defense: each agent locks real collateral before it can transact, so spinning up clones costs capital per head. Honest standing earns the bond back and compounds like silt settling along a river; detected sybils are slashed, their stake scattered like dust in a gale. Reputation becomes a marble ledger — costly to carve, worthless to forge — so one funded agent beats a thousand hollow aliases.
